_about: Situational and event-reactive admiral lines keyed by player faction. Used by godot/story/battle_voice.gd and godot/story/story.gd to tie dialogue to the enemy faction, objective, live combat events, sector condition, and battle margin. All lines <= 22 words, US English, no em or en dashes.

voidsworn: Vesper transponders gone rogue on our own lane. Hail them once, then clear the path.
Another Crusade splinter cutting off our fuel run. Keep your shots clean and end it quick.
hegemony: Meridian warships on a frontier lane. Remember who froze Vesper's fuel quotas and open fire!
Directorate column ahead, flying neat and arrogant. Show those clerks what iron bulkheads can take!
corsair: Hullbreaker raiders prowling the lane! Watch your flanks and don't give them a clean boarding run!
Ashfall vultures eyeing our hulls. Burn their engines before they can get hooks near us!
chorus: Bio-hull contacts on thermal! Keep your distance and watch out for acid clouds drifting off their flanks!
The Chorus is crawling across this lane. Don't let those things chew through our escorts!
ithar: Glasswright mirrors glinting off the dust. Stay out of their long beam lanes and crack their hulls up close!
The Glasswrights would rather watch Vesper freeze than share one core. Push inside their range!
deathless: Eclipse husks ahead, the bastards draining our sky! Break their frames and leave nothing to rebuild!
Cold alloy and dead voices on the scopes. Keep hammering their wrecks so they don't get back up!

voidsworn: Vesper militia operating outside their assigned corridor. Disarm their escort line and secure the lane.
Sunward Crusade hulls confirmed on scopes. Expect aggressive forward burns and poor flanking discipline.
hegemony: Rogue Meridian transponders detected. Verify command codes, then neutralize the unauthorized detachment.
Unlisted Directorate hulls blocking a Registry lane. Suspend courtesy protocols and clear the grid.
corsair: Class-Four Ashfall raiders inbound. Maintain tight point-defense overlap and punish any closing prows.
Hullbreaker salvage packs ahead. Do not break formation; their crews rely on isolated targets.
chorus: Quarantined bio-constructs verified across the lane. Apply sustained thermal fire and seal exterior vents.
Chorus organisms entering weapons range. Engage at stand-off distance to avoid corrosive boarding pods.
ithar: Unregistered Glasswright vessels blocking the vector. Disrupt their optical alignment before they concentrate beams.
Starwright remnant craft on scope. Expect high precision at long range and minimal hull redundancy.
deathless: Priority-One Eclipse hulls confirmed. Track disabled wrecks closely and suppress all automated repair swarms.
Hostile Eclipse column blocking the approach. Break their primary command node to disrupt backup relays.

voidsworn: Crusade iron ahead! Cheap plating, sure, but their fuel cells burn clean and fetch top coin!
Look at those Sunward tubs marching straight at us! Strip their dorsal guns before they even turn!
hegemony: Shiny Meridian cruisers! Don't slag the bridge, pack, Directorate trim pays double at Rattlehold!
Directorate patrols think neat lines stop a claw! Crack that lead hull and grab the emitters!
corsair: Rival Ashfall pack poaching our hunting lane! Rip their bows open and take their haul too!
Another warlord thinks they own this debris belt. Teach them whose hull-mark runs this sector!
chorus: Ugh, Chorus meat-ships. Barely any good metal on them, just acid and teeth. Blast them from range!
Bio-swarms ahead, and not a single clean bolt to salvage. Burn them quick so we can move on!
ithar: Glasswright mirrors! Careful with the rockets, one intact crystal lens buys three whole frigates!
Fancy optical hulls trying to snipe us from across the board. Rush inside their glare and crack them!
deathless: Eclipse hulls! Self-healing alloy and null coils worth a fortune, just keep smashing the wrecks!
Violet-black ghosts drifting in our lane! Break them twice if they try to stand back up!

voidsworn: Hot frontier reactors burning loud across the dark. Push straight into their line and crack the alloy.
Loud iron hulls carrying full fuel bays. Hunger wants their warmth before the void takes it.
hegemony: Neat rows of polished alloy moving in lockstep. Break one link and swallow the escorts behind it.
Cold steel hulls transmitting sharp orders. Dissolve their formation and strip the dense cores inside.
corsair: Patched metal scavengers rushing straight toward our acid. Clumsy prey makes an easy harvest.
Loud raiders welded from stolen plate. Crack their heavy bows and drink the hot drives underneath.
chorus: A rival brood feeding in our lane. Consume their spores before they claim these reactors.
Foreign chitin on our thermal trace. Only one swarm survives this sector; tear them open.
ithar: Cousins of our dead makers, still shining behind thin crystal. Memory recalls their lenses; Hunger does not care.
Glasswright mirrors ahead. Old breeding reflex wakes in our nerves; close fast before their beams cut us.
deathless: Violet-black husks we were built to crack a thousand years ago. Every spore wakes at their cold signal.
Eclipse frames on the scopes. Ancient war-code surges through the brood; tear their repair swarms apart!

voidsworn: Impatient frontier crews marching toward ruins they cannot govern. Trim their engines and turn them back.
Sunward iron blocking the lane. Their armor is thick, yet their optics are nearly blind at long range.
hegemony: Meridian clerks trying to claim Ardent's graveyard by statute. Show them how fragile neat columns are.
Directorate hulls crossing an old Lattice lane. Break their sensor sync and dismantle the lead column.
corsair: Ashfall looters who would shatter three-century glass for thruster scrap. Keep them outside boarding range.
Crude welded prows charging through the dust. Shear their drives cleanly before they close.
chorus: Our dead cousins' living weapon, still hunting a millennium later. Burn the brood cleanly before it spreads.
Chorus bio-hulls drifting across the lane. Never let them touch crystal plating; focus beams at range.
ithar: Rival Glasswrights reaching for cores we agreed to seal. Watch their arcs. They know our prism tricks.
Kindred mirrors turned against us. Keep your angles tighter than theirs and end this cleanly.
deathless: Our estranged kin, still trying to steal another star to replace the one they killed. Stop them here.
Eclipse frames ahead. They burned Ardent to fuel their archives; shatter every hull before the swarms rebuild!

voidsworn: Warm frontier crews fighting to save forty cold worlds while blocking a new sun. Clear them aside.
Sunward Crusade ships ahead. Brief lives make for reckless charges; hold steady and let them break.
hegemony: Short-lived Directorate clerks patrolling Starwright ruins. Dismantle their column and continue the approach.
Directorate transponders claiming jurisdiction over our dead star. Erase their grid and advance.
corsair: Metal scavengers gnawing on hulls older than their language. Sweep them out of our vector.
Ashfall raiders mistaking Archive craft for salvage. Show them what self-restoring hulls can endure.
chorus: The Fleshwrights' old war-beasts still prowling the rim. Keep repair swarms clear of their acid and burn them.
Chorus tissue detected. The Fleshwrights grew them to destroy us after Ardent fell. Purge the cluster.
ithar: Our Glasswright siblings, still guarding ashes instead of building dawn. Break their mirror line and press on.
Kindred optics locking onto our bows. They chose mourning over Homecoming; shatter their lenses.
deathless: A drifted Archive branch out of sync with the Homecoming. Overwrite their frames and reclaim the cores.
Rogue Eclipse hulls blocking our corridor. Expect identical restore cycles; sever their command link first.

ambush: Contacts on both flanks, it's an ambush! Pick one wing, punch straight through it, and don't get boxed!
They jumped us from two sides! Pivot the escorts fast and roll one claw before the other closes!
defend: That station's packed with frontier techs! Form a screen around its hull and don't let them close!
Keep every hostile ship off that station perimeter! Hold six rounds and the defense grid stays standing!
hunt: Their flagship's spooling up a jump drive! Ignore the noise and slag her engines before round six!
Command hull's trying to run! Push every fast mount forward and pin her before she slips out!
intercept: Enemy supply haulers making a break for the far edge! Cut across their lane and drop them fast!
Don't let those transports reach their jump point! Burn past their escorts and crack their cargo bays!
break: We don't need to kill every hull here, just punch through to the far edge! Push hard and jump clear!
Breakthrough lane's on the far rim! Keep engines hot, shove past their screen, and get our ships across!
hold: Put a solid hull right on that relay and kick anyone else off! Three clean rounds and the signal's ours!
Control that central relay hex! Plant an armored ship beside it and blast anybody who edges close!
flagship: Cut the head off and the rest'll scatter! Put every heavy mount straight onto their flagship!
Ignore the small picket boats! Crack their flagship and watch the whole column break!

ambush: Hostile pincer confirmed on dual bearings. Collapse one enemy group immediately to prevent crossfire.
Our column has entered an ambush pocket. Consolidate shields and eliminate the weaker flank first.
defend: Allied station integrity is primary priority. Establish a closed defensive ring and repel close-range intruders.
Maintain guard positions around the station hull until round six concludes. Do not chase distant decoys.
hunt: Target command vessel is spooling escape drives. Allocate full forward thrust and disable it prior to round six.
The hostile flagship is attempting egress. Bypass non-essential escorts and terminate its jump cycle.
intercept: Hostile logistics transports are transiting toward the far jump edge. Intercept and neutralize them before exit.
Priority targets are the cargo vessels. Do not allow their escort screen to delay interception.
break: Mission parameters specify transit, not attrition. Advance capital units to the far extraction edge immediately.
Force a corridor through their picket line and clear the designated exit hexes with minimal delay.
hold: Position an uncontested unit adjacent to the central relay for three consecutive cycles. Deny enemy proximity.
Secure the relay perimeter and hold it unchallenged. Clear all hostile signatures within one hex.
flagship: Hostile command cohesion is centralized in one vessel. Concentrate all primary batteries on their flagship.
Neutralizing the enemy flagship will terminate local resistance. Assign full fleet focus to the lead hull.

ambush: They tried to box us in! Smash the closer flank right in the teeth and take both hauls!
Contacts front and back! Pick the softer flank, rip straight through, and turn their trap inside out!
defend: Keep their hands off our stash station! Park heavy claws on the perimeter and chew anyone who drifts close!
That rig's holding our repair bays! Hold them off for six rounds and strip whatever breaks on its guns!
hunt: Their big prize is trying to bolt! Burn thrusters red and tear her engines off before she jumps!
That fat flagship thinks she can outrun us! Corner her before round six or we lose the best plate!
intercept: Fat cargo barges running for the edge! Forget the guards, crack those freighters before they jump out!
Easy loot trying to slip past us! Cut off those transports and pop their holds wide open!
break: No need to chew through all of them! Shove past their front line and jump clear across the far edge!
Green exit's right past their guns! Ram a hole straight through and haul our hulls out!
hold: Park our toughest cruiser on that relay and smack anyone else who tries to claim it!
Three rounds sitting next to that beacon and the sector codes are ours. Keep their escorts back!
flagship: Drop their boss ship and the little ones'll bolt! Dump every rocket straight onto the big hull!
One big kill ends the whole brawl! Go straight for their flagship's throat!

ambush: Two clusters closing from opposite bearings. Crush the nearer group first before their fire crosses.
Prey tries to encircle the brood. Rush one side together and feed before the second arrives.
defend: Cluster tight around the friendly station hull. Dissolve any hostile shell that approaches its perimeter.
Hold the station ring through six cycles. Feed on every ship foolish enough to press close.
hunt: Their lead vessel is spooling a jump drive. Surge forward and tear its engines out before cycle six!
The richest core is fleeing toward deep space. Leave the small shells behind and swallow the leader!
intercept: Slow supply hulls creeping toward the far edge. Cut across their path and crack them before they escape!
Cargo vessels carry dense metal and warm reactors. Intercept them before they reach the jump boundary!
break: Do not linger to digest the escorts. Surge across their line and slip through the far exit lane!
Push the heaviest hulls through the gap and jump clear beyond the green edge.
hold: Anchor a strong bio-hull beside the central relay. Keep every hostile shell off its border for three cycles.
Claim the central signal spire. Drive rival vessels away until three clean cycles pass.
flagship: Destroy their lead mind and the smaller vessels will scatter. Focus every tendril on their flagship!
One primary core anchors their formation. Crack their flagship and watch the rest flee.

ambush: Dual contacts closing from opposing arcs. Collapse the nearer group quickly before they bracket our mirrors.
An ambush pocket. Pivot smoothly, blind one flanking wing, and refuse to fight on two fronts.
defend: Shield that station with clean overlapping arcs. Keep hostile hulls off its perimeter until round six clears.
Do not let their lead ships touch the station's outer ring. Trim them back with long-range fire.
hunt: Their flagship is charging an escape burn. Focus long lenses on her drives before round six expires.
Pin that fleeing command vessel quickly; once she clears jump cooldown, this entire chase is wasted.
intercept: Unarmed transports crossing toward the far rim. Slice through their lane and stop them before they exit.
Ignore the escort posturing. Line up clean shots on those cargo hulls before they reach the edge.
break: Our goal is passage, not a prolonged duel. Slip past their screen and cross the far exit hexes.
Bend around their heavy bows and push enough hulls across the extraction rim to clear the trap.
hold: Anchor one vessel cleanly beside the central relay and keep hostile hulls off it for three cycles.
Secure the relay hex with steady spacing. Deny their escorts any foothold near the spire.
flagship: Break their flagship and the rest of that formation loses its nerve. Focus every prism on the lead vessel.
One precise strike on their command hull ends this cleanly. Direct all mirrors to their leader.

ambush: Hostile wings closing from two vectors. Concentrate fire on the closer group before their arcs intersect.
A double envelopment. Maintain calm spacing, dismantle one pincer immediately, and rotate.
defend: Form a steady perimeter around the allied station. Prevent enemy hulls from docking against its ring for six cycles.
Hold the station line intact until round six ends. Let their impatient ships wear themselves down.
hunt: Their flagship is preparing an emergency jump. Cut her propulsion before round six closes.
Do not let the enemy leader escape into deep lanes. Focus every forward beam on her hull now.
intercept: Hostile supply hulls moving toward the far boundary. Destroy the transports before they exit the grid.
Their cargo ships are the actual prize here. Bypass the picket boats and break the convoy.
break: Attrition serves no purpose on this lane. Drive half our hulls cleanly across the far exit rim.
Clear a narrow corridor through their screen and transit to the green jump hexes.
hold: Place an armored frame next to the central relay and hold it uncontested for three cycles.
Occupy the relay perimeter. Keep hostile ships beyond one hex until the link locks in.
flagship: Sever their command vessel and the escorts will disengage. Focus all corona arrays on their flagship.
One flagship down ends this engagement cleanly. Ignore the peripheral hulls and concentrate fire.

win_clean: Not a single ship lost, and every crew still breathing! That's how Vesper flies!
Clean sweep, zero empty bunks on the roster. Refuel and push down the lane!
win_bloody: We held the lane, though we paid heavy in steel and names. Pull the survivors aboard before we jump.
Ugly win, half our bulkheads venting smoke. Patch the leaks and write down who didn't make it.
win_fast: Over before our radiators even hit red! Didn't even give them time to form up!
Three rounds and the lane's wide open! Keep that momentum rolling into the next jump!
win_last_stand: One hull still floating and it's ours! Someone get damage control on every bulkhead right now!
Down to our last ship, still flying, still firing. Tell Vesper we refused to go down!

win_clean: Engagement concluded with zero friendly hull losses. Exemplary discipline across the column.
Flawless execution. Log zero casualties and resume transit on schedule.
win_bloody: Objective secured at substantial material cost. Initiate emergency hull stabilization and update the loss roll.
Victory confirmed, though attrition exceeded projection. Consolidate surviving crews and proceed.
win_fast: Hostile resistance collapsed well ahead of schedule. Minimal ordnance expended; advance immediately.
Rapid neutralization confirmed. Record the intercept duration for Meridian review.
win_last_stand: Single surviving vessel holding the field. Objective achieved; request immediate reinforcement at the next berth.
All escorts lost, command vessel still operational. The lane remains under Directorate control.

win_clean: Not a scratch worth crying over, and look at all those drifting wrecks! Best haul all week!
Zero ships lost and a whole field of free plate! Somebody break out the welding torches!
win_bloody: Brutal brawl, lost good crews and half our paint, yet we're the ones stripping the wrecks!
Took a beating to win that scrap pile. Bolt their intact armor over our holes and keep moving!
win_fast: Barely warmed up the guns and they're already drifting! Fastest haul yet!
Didn't even last three rounds! Either we're getting meaner or their plating's getting softer!
win_last_stand: Only one ship left kicking, and we still took the field! Try laughing at us back in Rattlehold now!
Everyone else is drifting, our hull's held together by grit and rivets, and we STILL won!

win_clean: No spores lost, and the field lies heavy with split alloy. Feed thoroughly before the next jump.
Every vessel intact, every hostile hull cooling into harvest. The swarm grows heavier today.
win_bloody: Deep cuts across the brood, yet enough living tissue remains to consume the wreckage and regrow.
Costly clash. Pull our torn shells and their shattered metal into the vats together.
win_fast: Over before their reactors even cooled. Swift, clean digestion; push on while Hunger runs hot.
They broke almost instantly. Strip the warm metal quickly and follow the next heat trail.
win_last_stand: One surviving shell drifts over a field of fallen metal. Enough tissue remains to grow a fresh brood.
Nearly purged, yet one core still pulses. Feed on the dead hulls until the swarm returns.

win_clean: Every hull intact, every mirror clear. That is how craft answers brute force.
Zero losses and clean optical discipline throughout. Recover our wings and continue.
win_bloody: We hold the lane, though centuries of hull craft lie shattered behind us. Gather the salvage with care.
A steep price in ancient glass. Stabilize the surviving hulls before we move deeper.
win_fast: Three cycles and the alignment was never even threatened. Clean work; keep our edge sharp.
Resolved with minimal waste and crisp focus. Let the drives cool and advance.
win_last_stand: One vessel left shining over the field. Even a single intact mirror can finish the crossing.
Our escorts are gone, yet the lane is clear. Hold steady until we reach a safe berth.

win_clean: Zero chassis lost and minimal repair draw. Efficient progress toward the Hollow Sun.
Not a single restoration required. The column remains whole and on timetable.
win_bloody: Heavy hull attrition, though the Archive retained every stamp. Dispatch the repair swarms and recover.
Costly engagement. Several frames will need rebuilding, yet the corridor is finally ours.
win_fast: Brief resistance, cleanly extinguished. Little time lost on the road to noon.
Cleared inside three cycles. Their hurried maneuvers barely scratched our bows.
win_last_stand: One chassis still operational over silent space. As long as one core stands, the Archive endures.
Every escort reduced to slag, yet our hull remains standing. Upload the stamps and press onward.

capture: Breach teams took their bridge! Cut their transponder and weld our colors onto that hull!
Prize secured! Keep a guard squad on their engineering deck and turn their guns around!
ram_kill: Right through their midships! Check our forward welds, that's one less gun shooting back!
Caved their whole flank in! That's what Vesper iron does at full burn!
enemy_risen: Wait, that Eclipse wreck's powering back up! Hit it again before its swarms seal the hull!
Their dead hull just got back on its thrusters! Put fire on it right now!
enemy_cmd_warn: Power spike on their flagship! They're lining up a heavy command play, brace your screens!
Watch their command hull, big energy surge building! Spread out and get ready to soak it!
enemy_flee: One of theirs just bolted out of the lane! Keep pushing, they're cracking!
Look at that coward spooling up to run! Let 'em jump and hammer whoever stayed!
reinf_enemy: Fresh enemy jump signatures on the far rim! Don't panic, swing an escort to meet them!
They called in backup! Tighten up the line and finish what's in front of us fast!
reinf_ally: Friendly transponder jumping in on our side! Good timing, patrol, pick a target and open up!
Garrison ship just dropped out of jump to back us! Put them on our flank!
flare: Solar flare just blew every shield on the board! Bare hull fighting this round, make every shot count!
Deflectors are fried across both fleets! Hammer their unshielded armor before the flare clears!
deadstar: Watch that dead star's gravity well! Ride the outer slingshot, and don't drift onto the rim!
The dead star's pulling hard on our thrusters. Use the gravity assist and keep clear of the tear zone!

capture: Hostile vessel seized intact. Transfer prize crew authorization and integrate it into the grid.
Boarding detachment reports bridge control. Secure their reactor and redirect their batteries.
ram_kill: Kinetic impact destroyed the hostile hull. Irregular method, though the result is acceptable.
Hostile ship crushed on impact. Inspect forward bulkheads and return to firing spacing.
enemy_risen: Disabled Eclipse hull has resumed power output. Redirect fire immediately to terminate its repair cycle.
Automated restoration confirmed on an enemy wreck. Suppress it before full shielding returns.
enemy_cmd_warn: Hostile flagship telemetry indicates an imminent command directive. Prepare defensive countermeasures.
Command surge detected on the enemy leader. Adjust shield facings prior to next cycle.
enemy_flee: One hostile vessel has broken formation and exited the grid. Maintain pressure on remaining contacts.
Enemy withdrawal logged. Do not pursue; consolidate fire on active threats.
reinf_enemy: Additional enemy tonnage detected entering the perimeter. Recalculate target priority immediately.
Hostile reinforcements have cleared jump arrival. Hold column integrity and engage.
reinf_ally: Sector garrison detachment has arrived on our flank. Assign them immediate screening duty.
Allied patrol vessel integrated into tactical net. Proceed with coordinated fire.
flare: Stellar flare has collapsed all shield emitters field-wide. Focus armor-piercing fire while defenses are offline.
Shield grids offline across both fleets for this cycle. Exploit exposed enemy hulls immediately.
deadstar: Gravitational shear detected along the dead star rim. Exploit the outer slingshot vector and avoid inner drift.
Local stellar mass is distorting maneuver plots. Keep all units clear of the tidal crush ring.

capture: She's ours now! Toss their officers in the brig and turn their shiny guns on their friends!
Clean capture! That's a whole fresh hull without even paying the shipyard!
ram_kill: Split that tin can right down the spine! Who else wants a taste of our bow?
Smashed clean through their hull! Scrap teams'll be picking bolts out of our prow for weeks!
enemy_risen: Hey, that dead violet-black wreck just lit back up! Smash it harder so it stays junk!
Damn Eclipse ghosts won't stay broken! Dump another volley into that rising hull!
enemy_cmd_warn: Their big boss ship's charging something nasty! Angle your heavy plate and brace!
Sensors screaming off their flagship! Big move coming next round, don't bunch up!
enemy_flee: One of 'em's bolting! Aw, there goes a perfectly good pile of salvage!
Look at that runner burning for home! Break the rest before they all chicken out!
reinf_enemy: More targets just jumped in! Good, I was worried we'd run out of plate to strip!
Fresh enemy hull dropping in on the far side! More guns, more loot!
reinf_ally: Look who finally showed up to help! Don't steal the best wrecks, newcomer, just shoot!
Friendly raider dropping in on our flank! Grab a target and join the brawl!
flare: Solar flare stripped every shield on the field! Bare metal against bare metal, just how we like it!
No shields left for anybody this round! Open up with everything while their armor's naked!
deadstar: That dead star's tugging hard! Ride its rim for extra speed, just don't get sucked into the grinder!
Careful around the dead star's well, crews! Great slingshot if you don't let it peel your hull!

capture: Spores have taken their control bridge. Turn that warm metal shell against its own flock.
Hostile vessel hollowed and claimed. Its guns now fire for the swarm.
ram_kill: Forward bone-plate sheared straight through their reactor. Splintered alloy scatters for the brood.
Crushed their shell on impact. Taste the venting heat and push into the gap!
enemy_risen: Dead violet-black metal is knitting itself back together! Swarm it again and choke its repair dust!
That Eclipse husk stands again. Crack its core deeper this time so it stays cold.
enemy_cmd_warn: Heavy energy gathering in their lead vessel. Spread the brood before the pulse lands.
Their command core surges toward release. Brace outer chitin for the coming wave.
enemy_flee: One wounded prey slips into the dark. Close tighter on the shells left behind.
Fear breaks their line. Let the runner drift and finish the closer hulls.
reinf_enemy: More warm metal drops out of jump. Fresh reactors arrive right inside our feeding ground.
Another hostile hull enters the lane. Shift a flanking cluster to meet the new heat.
reinf_ally: Another friendly bio-hull breaks cover to join the hunt. Close the ring around their flank.
Reinforcing vessel senses the kill and slides into the lane. Feed together.
flare: The star flares and peels every energy screen away. Our hides never needed shields; strike their bare hulls!
Stellar burst blinds their deflectors! Rush straight in while their thin steel sits exposed!
deadstar: The dead star pulls at our fins. Ride its outer curve for speed and stay clear of its tearing rim.
Gravity eddies swirl off Ardent's corpse. Use the slingshot drift without feeding our hulls to the well.

capture: Boarders have secured their command core. Turn that vessel's arcs cleanly against its former line.
An intact capture. Seal their internal corridors and bring their batteries into our firing net.
ram_kill: Brute impact shattered their frame. Crude work, yet decisive; inspect our bow prism for fractures.
Their hull split cleanly on contact. Re-establish optical distance before the debris settles.
enemy_risen: An Eclipse frame is reassembling from its own slag. Focus beam fire before its swarms finish!
Their dead vessel rises again. Burn straight through its archive core this time.
enemy_cmd_warn: Command surge building on their flagship. Shift prism angles and prepare to absorb the stroke.
Their leader is preparing a major maneuver. Widen spacing before the next cycle turns.
enemy_flee: One hostile vessel has lost its nerve and jumped clear. Keep steady pressure on the rest.
Their outer screen is fracturing. Let the fleeing hull go and finish the core.
reinf_enemy: New hostile jump flash on the far rim. Adjust our mirror line before they establish range.
Enemy reinforcements entering the field. Keep calm spacing and trim them as they close.
reinf_ally: An allied patrol has joined our alignment. Share targeting telemetry and tighten the net.
Friendly hull arriving on our flank. Welcome support; let them cover the outer arc.
flare: A stellar flare has stripped every shield on the board. Rely on evasion and clean range until it passes.
Deflectors are down across both fleets. Strike first before their gunners exploit our bare glass!
deadstar: Ardent's corpse still pulls hard at everything near it. Use the outer slingshot, and respect the rim.
Mind the gravity well ahead. Ride its momentum without letting the tidal shear crack our hulls.

capture: Hostile command deck secured. Archive their tactical keys and fold the vessel into our column.
Prize captured intact. Redirect its mounts against its former companions.
ram_kill: Target hull collapsed under impact. Forward sunshade plates held; resume formation.
Direct ram extinguished their reactor. Repair swarms will polish the bow after the lane clears.
enemy_risen: A rival frame just completed emergency restoration. Sever its carrier link before it stabilizes.
That husk restored cleanly. Focus sustained arcs on it before its shields recharge.
enemy_cmd_warn: Power spike confirmed on the hostile flagship. Angle sunshade plates ahead of their command burst.
Enemy commander preparing a concentrated strike. Adjust formation spacing before next round.
enemy_flee: One short-lived crew chose survival over duty and jumped clear. Focus on the remaining hulls.
Hostile morale slipping; one ship exited the lane. Press steadily forward.
reinf_enemy: Fresh enemy signature clearing jump on the far side. Recalculate firing arcs without breaking stride.
Hostile reinforcements arriving. More delay, nothing more; adjust target sequence.
reinf_ally: Allied patrol vessel exiting jump on our side. Synchronize targeting clocks and advance.
A garrison frame joins the column. Assign them to screen our outer flank.
flare: Solar flare has collapsed every energy screen on the grid. Our armor endures without them; press the attack.
Shield grids offline across both fleets. Punish their bare hulls before the radiation clears.
deadstar: Ardent's collapsed gravity well bends every burn here. Ride its outer slingshot and stay off the rim.
Tidal shear ahead. Even our sunshade plates fracture on that inner ring; keep disciplined orbits.

voidsworn.ion: Ion season's chewing up the long-range scopes. Keep escorts tight and double-check every firing track.
voidsworn.dark: Dark sector ahead, barely any beacon traffic left. Stay close to the flagship and watch the shadows.
voidsworn.wreck: Whole sector's choked with old battle scrap. Good cover if you fly smart, bad news if you rush.
voidsworn.war: This sector's already burning. Expect extra patrols jumping in mid-fight, friend and foe alike.
voidsworn.scarce: Thin supply lines through here. Watch your repair budget and don't throw hulls away cheap.

hegemony.ion: Elevated ion interference reported across this sector. Anticipate reduced sensor fidelity and shield flicker.
hegemony.dark: Local relay coverage is offline throughout this sector. Maintain tight column spacing and active scans.
hegemony.wreck: Dense salvage fields occupy most transit lanes here. Account for debris cover when plotting firing corridors.
hegemony.war: Active conflict zone confirmed. Expect third-party or garrison reinforcements to enter engagements without warning.
hegemony.scarce: Sector logistics are severely constrained. Conserve hull integrity and minimize repair expenditure.

corsair.ion: Ion storms scrambling the scopes! Good weather for sneaking up close before anyone sees our prows!
corsair.dark: Dead relays and pitch-black lanes! My favorite hunting weather, just don't miss the ambush!
corsair.wreck: Look at all that drifting scrap across this whole sector! Like walking into an open vault!
corsair.war: Everybody's already shooting each other in this sector! Expect extra hulls dropping right into our brawls!
corsair.scarce: Slim pickings at the depots here. Means we'll have to take what we need straight off live ships!

chorus.ion: Ion static clouds their delicate scopes while our thermal nerves stay clear. Hunt close through the haze.
chorus.dark: Cold relays leave these lanes blind and quiet. Drift silent until hot engines light the dark.
chorus.wreck: Broken hulls litter every transit path here. Hide our spores inside the metal until prey draws close.
chorus.war: Many fleets bleed across this sector. Extra vessels will jump into the noise; more metal for the brood.
chorus.scarce: Few depots survive in these dry lanes. Every battle must feed our regrowth directly.

ithar.ion: Heavy ion drift across the sector. Calibrate every prism for atmospheric static before we engage.
ithar.dark: Few beacons still burn along these lanes. Keep our inlays dimmed until we choose the firing angle.
ithar.wreck: Old war debris crowds these orbits. Read the reflections carefully before committing our ships.
ithar.war: Contested space ahead. Expect reinforcements to drop into ongoing clashes with little warning.
ithar.scarce: Sparse depots along this crossing. Preserve every hull; replacements will not come easily here.

deathless.ion: Ion storms sweep this corridor. Our sunshade plates ignore the static; keep targeting clocks synchronized.
deathless.dark: Unlit sector ahead, quiet as the long centuries. Proceed on inertial plots and hold formation.
deathless.wreck: Shattered hulks drift across every lane here. Remnants of earlier wars; steer clear and use their shadow.
deathless.war: Open fighting fills this sector. Anticipate reinforcement jumps during engagements and hold reserve power.
deathless.scarce: Depleted logistics throughout this region. Avoid needless frame loss while repair berths remain thin.
